verdict.rationale: Lithic documents issuing virtual cards scoped with spend limits and Authorization Rules (MCC, country, velocity, program/account/card level) and explicitly ties this to agentic workflows via its MCP server blog post and agentic-commerce solutions page, effectively letting an AI agent operate with a least-privilege payment credential. However, this is scoping at the card/authorization level, not a documented mechanism for scoping the underlying API key/credential itself (e.g., restricted API tokens or OAuth-style scopes for agent API access). Missing for 10: explicit API-key/credential scoping documentation (not just card controls), independent/hands-on verification of agent-specific credential issuance.
